method: Manual review of 50 live-collected employer descriptions, role duties, qualifications, and normalized locations across all four ATS platforms. Original findings and final corrected classifications are retained. This purposive sample exercises core roles, software-only roles, industrial supply-chain roles, degree restrictions, and ambiguous roles; it does not estimate an overall error rate.
